name: Dream Team
description: A Paoli HVAC contractor providing heating and cooling installation, repair, and maintenance.

hero.headline: Dream Team
hero.sub: Heating and cooling installation, repair, and maintenance for homes and small businesses.

items: Repair and diagnostic service for heating and cooling systems
Seasonal maintenance plans to catch problems before they fail
Serving Paoli and the surrounding area
Straightforward quotes before any job starts
Maintenance plans built to extend equipment life

story.heading: About
paragraphs: Dream Team handles the systems that keep a home comfortable year-round: furnaces in winter, AC units in summer.
The crew diagnoses the actual issue first, then quotes the fix plainly before starting work.

items: Call for a quote and get a clear price before any work begins.
Licensed technicians handle installation, repair, and maintenance.
Straight answers on what needs fixing now versus what can wait.

feature.heading: Heating and cooling that actually works
feature.text: From a dead furnace to a failing AC unit, the fix starts with an honest diagnosis, not a guess.

spotlight.heading: Maintenance that prevents the emergency call
spotlight.text: A seasonal tune-up catches small issues before they turn into a no-heat call in January.
